name: Project Context: repo doc browser, agent Context tab, skill Project context tab
description: Covers AC-6 (repo-scoped /context page: doc rows with path + folder badge, read-only markdown preview), AC-10 (agent editor Context tab: doc rows with checkbox/name/badge, filter input), and AC-15 (skill editor 'Project context to use' tab, equivalent section). The seeded demo repo's clonePath points at server/fixtures/demo-context-docs (specs/docs/insights markdown), so context.walkContext discovers real docs without a real git clone. Read-only seeded data — no model call, no context saved.

open the seeded Security Reviewer agent
navigate to the agent detail route
switch to the agent editor's Context tab
context tab is active in the URL
discovered doc row (name) renders in the Context tab
discovered doc row (path) renders in the Context tab
